confidence_note: Probabilities are model scores. Pure is a dataset category, not a chemical purity measurement.
calibration_note: Temperatures were fitted at video level; single-photo calibrated scores are descriptive.

powder.note: Positive class-specific visual attribution; independently normalized. Colour descriptor is held fixed.

colouring.note: Positive class-specific visual attribution; independently normalized. Colour descriptor is held fixed.

segmentation.note: Heuristic preprocessing mask, not a chemical annotation or dye segmentation.

colour_attribution.baseline: All-zero 54-dimensional descriptor; an artificial reference, not a Pure sample.
colour_attribution.scope: Colouring head only. Visual embedding held fixed. Contributions are to the predicted class logit, not percentages.

explanations.note: Attribution explains model behavior; it does not locate dye or measure concentration. The two CAMs use separate relative scales.
